buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Jodar gets a slim nod on freshness. Shelton has logged 132 games across 5 matches in 14 days, Jodar only 46 across 2.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Shelton holds a clear advantage on motivation and pressure. Shelton is on the way up (+50 Elo over 90 days) while Jodar has been sliding (-93). Shelton's comeback rate is 54% against 39% for Jodar, which matters if the first set slips away.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Conditions point fairly clearly to Shelton. Indoor Hard costs both players Elo relative to their overall rating: -34 for Shelton, -104 for Jodar. Shelton is the more proven player on Indoor Hard: 74% wins in 12 months against 65% for Jodar. Played indoors, so weather is not a factor.
